    How to play

    New here? Open the menu and play the Tutorial: short lessons, one idea at a time.

    A turn: both teams plan up to 3 actions in secret, one per player. Then the plans are revealed step by step: their move 1, your action 1, and so on.

    Length: 3 periods of 3:00. Each plan uses 4 seconds of the clock. Tied after the 3rd: one sudden-death overtime, then a shootout (playoffs: overtime until a goal).

    🥅 Shootout
    🥅 Shootout moves
    Your turn: draw your shooter's path on the ice — slide your finger from him (or tap where he stops: a straight line). He skates it at the speed you drew it.
    Where the path ends is where you shoot or deke: 3-4 squares from the net is best. Farther: the goalie has not moved. 2 squares: he may poke the puck away.
    Shoot: tap a corner (the buttons, or the targets on the net).
    Deke: tap one of the 8 moves — forehand–backhand, backhand–forehand, fake shot, Datsyuk, Forsberg, Nielsen, Kane, between the legs. Each shows its chance.
    Kane likes a slow approach: draw your path slowly.
    The same move twice: the goalie reads it.
